summary: Tested new Admin 'App-udseende' feature (app_bg_color + page_title_color) for Skægagamer. Backend: 21/21 pytest tests passing (4 new + 17 regression), confirming PUT/GET /api/admin/settings persists both new fields correctly and does NOT clobber pre-existing banner fields (banner_image_base64, banner_text, banner_bg_color, heading_color) when saving appearance-only payload. Frontend (mobile viewport 375x667, Playwright): 'App-udseende' section renders correctly below 'Banner' section with live preview box, two swatch rows (App-baggrundsfarve, Sideoverskrift-farve), and its own 'Gem udseende' save button. Tapping swatches updates the preview box live (bg color + text color). Save triggers 'Udseende gemt' success toast, and confirmed via computed CSS styles that all 5 tabs (Dagsoversigt, Agamer, Opgaver, Ugeplaner, Admin) consistently apply the selected app_bg_color as SafeAreaView background and page_title_color as the big title text color. Tapping 'none/X' for both swatches + save + reload correctly reverted all 5 tabs to default cream background (implicit COLORS.background) and default dark title color (rgb(28,25,23)) with no crash. Quick regression: dragon CRUD list, daily-overview API, and backend schedule-slot bulk-copy tests all still passing.
action_items: No blocking issues found for the App-udseende feature. Feature works end-to-end: backend persistence, live UI preview, global application across all 5 tabs, and graceful none/reset fallback.

Carried-over from prior session (not retested this round, still open per iteration_3.json): the 'Vælg alle' select-all toggle bug in schedule-slot copy-to-days sheet never switches to 'Fjern alle' - recommend fixing in a future session.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.tsx: appearance section cleanly mirrors the existing banner section's swatch UI pattern (SWATCH_COLORS reused), consistent testID naming (admin-app-bg-color-{hex}, admin-page-title-color-{hex}), and handleSaveAppearance() correctly sends ONLY {app_bg_color, page_title_color} in the PUT body so it doesn't clobber banner fields on the backend (backend uses model_dump(exclude_unset=True) which correctly excludes unsent fields).

AdminSettingsContext.tsx cleanly exposes appBgColor/pageTitleColor alongside existing banner fields; all 5 tab screens (index.tsx, dragons.tsx, lists.tsx, schedule.tsx, admin.tsx) consistently consume useAdminSettings() and apply conditional inline style overrides only when non-null - good fallback pattern (SafeAreaView style=[styles.safeArea, appBgColor ? {backgroundColor: appBgColor} : null]).

admin.tsx has grown to 648 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting Banner section and App-udseende section into separate sub-components (e.g. BannerSettingsCard, AppearanceSettingsCard) if more admin settings sections are added in future sessions.
Backend models.py AppSettings/AppSettingsUpdate additions are minimal, correct Optional[str] fields, no duplication.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - all App-udseende feature requirements verified working

seed_data_creation: None left behind. Test-created banner_text 'TEST_banner_text_for_appearance_check' and temporary color values used during pytest run were restored to original settings via module-scoped fixture teardown. Verified final DB state matches pre-test banner_bg_color/heading_color.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App-udseende feature (app_bg_color + page_title_color) fully verified working across backend persistence, live preview, global application on all 5 tabs, and none/reset fallback. No new bugs found this session. One pre-existing bug from iteration_3 remains open and untouched: 'Vælg alle' select-all toggle in schedule-slot copy-to-days sheet (schedule-slot-form.tsx / CopyToDaysSheet.tsx) never switches to 'Fjern alle' due to comparing against full DAYS_OF_WEEK.length/AGE_CATEGORIES.length instead of length-1 (current day/age is excluded from the array). Not part of this session's scope so left unfixed; recommend main agent addresses in a future pass.
